display.explanation: This observance encourages the Church to recognise disabled people’s gifts and participation, and to address barriers to belonging and access.
display.prompt: Pray for churches where disabled people can belong, participate and exercise their gifts.

sentences.label: Sentence
sentences.text: Those who find their life will lose it, and those who lose their life for Jesus’ sake will find it.

collects.text:
Holy God, grant us the
beginning of wisdom
and love to cast out every
fear:
that we may grow more
brave,
more ready to hear,
more ready to obey;
through Jesus Christ our
Redeemer.
Amen.
collects.sourceLabel: A New Zealand Prayer Book (2020), p. 646; reproduced in the 2026 resource

collects.text: Passionate God, your word burns like fire within, challenging us. By our baptism, we are immersed in your resurrecting love. When we are distracted by our own human relationships and needs, fill us with an abundance of your grace, that we may respond to your radical call to justice and hope for all people. With Jesus we pray. Amen.
collects.sourceLabel: J. Harrison & J. McAlpine, Our Daily Bread (2011), p. 26, as credited in the 2026 resource
